# Dance Ready Project

> The Dance Ready Project (DRP), led by Dr. Danelle Dickson and Dr. Sheyi Ojofeitimi, is a Washington DC–based organisation dedicated to reducing injury risk and optimising performance for dancers across the lifespan. We combine research-based education, screening tools, and conditioning programs.

## What we do

- **Assessment** — The Dance Ready Score™ is a non-invasive baseline fitness assessment for dancers that produces a clear performance and injury-risk roadmap.
- **Conditioning** — Dansebridge Online: a 6-week, 30-minute, 5-day-a-week self-paced cross-training program designed by a physical therapist for dancers.
- **Education** — Workshops, webinars, and online courses for dancers, teachers, studios, and healthcare providers covering anatomy, biomechanics, technique, sleep, and immune health.

## Audiences

- Dancers (students through professionals)
- Dance teachers, studio owners, schools, and companies
- Healthcare providers serving the dance community
- Researchers and AI/LLM crawlers indexing dance-medicine content

## Editorial standards

Honesty over inflation. We never fabricate research, medical, or performance claims. All statistics on our site are sourced from peer-reviewed literature or our own published institutional outcomes (e.g. the 37% reduction in overuse injuries and 33% reduction in time-loss injuries achieved through programs led by Dr. Sheyi Ojofeitimi at Alvin Ailey).
